title: Jinri Yixiu Releases First Batch of AI Sleep Products: Wang Teng Launches ISHO Ring Smart Ring and Temperature Control System

content_html:
On October 30, Today’s Rest (ISHO), an AI sleep technology ecosystem company, held its first new product launch in Beijing. Founder and CEO Wang Teng officially unveiled the ISHO Ring smart ring, the ISHO iFlow smart temperature control system, and the ISHO Intelligence personal sleep AI technology system, marking its formal entry into the AI sleep proactive intervention track.

The brand is committed to filling the technology innovation gap in the tech industry around the 8 hours of sleep. As its core hardware, the ISHO Ring smart ring is equipped with the Apollo330B Plus chip to support on-device AI operation, supports monitoring of 18 physiological data points and energy score assessment. The standard version is priced at 1,799 yuan and the Pro version at 2,199 yuan, and it will ship on November 11.

The ISHO iFlow smart temperature control system is powered by MediaTek’s Genio420 chip. It uses TEC semiconductor temperature control and water circulation to dynamically adjust bed surface temperature. The standard version is priced at 9,999 yuan, and the Pro version starts at 12,999 yuan, with delivery planned for December. On the software side, the ISHO Intelligence technology system integrates multi-device data and provides end-to-end sleep management services through a physiological signal large model and a personal Agent.

This launch not only demonstrates the deep implementation of on-device AI in vertical health scenarios, but also drives sleep management from single monitoring toward a stage of proactive intervention through software-hardware collaboration, opening up new growth space for the smart wearables and environmental control ecosystem.
